starting-out-talking-to-emelio.speaker: Emelio
starting-out-talking-to-emelio.text: Hang on... You're one of them easterners, aren't you?

starting-out-talking-to-emelio.speaker: Emelio
starting-out-talking-to-emelio.text: Kuani! I'm Emelio, and you might be just the person I need to help me out with an exciting new business venture!

starting-out-talking-to-emelio.prompt: Start the Meat and Greet quest?

steps.player: What business venture?

steps.speaker: Emelio
steps.text: Well as an easterner, I've no doubt you're all too familiar with the wonder that is the kabit!

steps.player: Kabit? What's a kabit?

steps.speaker: Emelio
steps.text: You don't know? But how could you not know? My life was changed forever when I tried one!

steps.speaker: Emelio
steps.text: Believe it or not, I never used to be keen on opening the Kingdom to outsiders. In fact, I even spent some time as part of the Varlaless movement.

steps.speaker: Emelio
steps.text: But then I tried a kabit, and it changed everything! If that's the kind of food you easterners can make, then as far as I'm concerned, you're welcome here any day of the week!

steps.player: Okay... but what's a kabit?

steps.speaker: Emelio
steps.text: A kabit! The amazing blend of meat, spices and salad, all wrapped in bread! Genius!

steps.player: Oh, you mean a kebab!

steps.speaker: Emelio
steps.text: Yes, kebab! Brilliant!

steps.player: But what do kebabs have to do with this business venture?

steps.speaker: Emelio
steps.text: Well, quite simply, I wish to bring the kebab to Varlamore. Everyone here deserves a chance to taste their brilliance!

steps.player: So you're opening a kebab shop?

steps.speaker: Emelio
steps.text: Exactly!

steps.player: I see. So what is it you need help with?

steps.speaker: Emelio
steps.text: My hope is to blend ingredients from the east with ones from right here in Varlamore. The end result will be a mighty kebab just like you easterners make, but with a Varlamorian twist!

steps.speaker: Emelio
steps.text: Problem is, some of the ingredients I've ordered haven't arrived yet. Would you be able to go and see what the delay is?

steps.player: Which ingredients haven't arrived?

steps.speaker: Emelio
steps.text: We're still missing the Kharidian spices I ordered in. The Spice Merchant in the Bazaar was sorting that out for me. We don't have the buffalo meat either. That was coming from Alba at Ortus Farm.

steps.player: Okay, I guess I can go see where they've got to.

steps.speaker: Emelio
steps.text: Kuani! I look forward to your return.

steps.player: Sorry, but I think I'll have to pass on this one.

steps.text: Well the good news is that his spices arrived this morning. The bad news is that I can't get the box open.

steps.text: Well this is the first time I've ever had to order in spices from the east, so I needed to find a reputable supplier. I ended up going with a guy called Ali Morrisane who seemed like he knew his stuff.

making-the-ultimate-kebab-talking-to-eme.speaker: Emelio

making-the-ultimate-kebab-talking-to-eme.speaker: Emelio

making-the-ultimate-kebab-talking-to-eme.speaker: Emelio

guerilla-marketing.text: Nice and simple really. Before the contest starts, we run a couple of adverts for local businesses. You get a few minutes to promote your product however you feel suitable.

steps.speaker: Colosseum Announcer
steps.text: Welcome, one and all, to the Fortis Colosseum! We have a thrilling event lined up for you today, but first, we have something new to show you!

steps.speaker: Colosseum Announcer
steps.text: Introducing the kebab! This delicacy comes straight from the east and is just the thing to give you the strength you need after a hard day of work.

steps.speaker: Colosseum Announcer
steps.text: Indeed, observe the strength provided by a single bite of one!
The player eats the kebab.

steps.speaker: Minotaur
steps.text: Huh? Human... eat... friend?

steps.player: What? No, it's a kebab. The meat is... buffalo... I think.

steps.speaker: Minotaur
steps.text: Kebab... is... minotaur?

steps.player: No. It's buffalo.

steps.speaker: Minotaur
steps.text: Human... eat... minotaur! Human... die!

steps.player: Oh boy...
I need to prepare first.

steps.speaker: Lelia
steps.text: Well make it quick.

guerilla-marketing-talking-to-leila-afte.speaker: Lelia
guerilla-marketing-talking-to-leila-afte.text: Are you ready? Your advertising slot is coming up and I don't intend to delay the contest for you.
If the player does not have the other test kebab in their inventory:
If the player has the other test kebab in their inventory:

guerilla-marketing-talking-to-emilio-aft.speaker: Emelio
guerilla-marketing-talking-to-emilio-aft.text: Nilsal, friend. Have you taken those kebabs to Lelia at the Colosseum yet?
If the player does not have the other test kebab in their inventory:
If the player has the other test kebab in their inventory:

guerilla-marketing-talking-to-emilio-aft.player: I have, but I need to go back and speak with her again.

steps.speaker: Emelio
steps.text: Then you should do so at once!

guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-afte.player: That minotaur tried to kill me!

guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-afte.speaker: Lelia
guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-afte.text: Yes, he doesn't seem too happy about those kebabs. I'll speak to the beastmaster about it. In the meantime, you'd better get in there and deal with him.

guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-afte.speaker: Lelia
guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-afte.text: Because if you don't, no one will want to buy those kebabs of yours.

guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-agai.speaker: Lelia
guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-agai.text: Ready to go back in? If you don't deal with that minotaur, no one will want to buy those kebabs of yours.

guerilla-marketing-talking-to-emilio-aft.speaker: Emelio
guerilla-marketing-talking-to-emilio-aft.text: Nilsal, friend. Have you taken those kebabs to Lelia at the Colosseum yet?

guerilla-marketing-talking-to-emilio-aft.player: I have. She set me up with a slot to promote them to the crowd, but there's been a bit of an issue.

guerilla-marketing-talking-to-emilio-aft.speaker: Emelio
guerilla-marketing-talking-to-emilio-aft.text: Well, then you'd better get back there and sort it out.

guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-afte.speaker: Lelia
guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-afte.text: You put on a good performance in there. The crowd seemed very impressed.

guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-afte.speaker: Lelia
guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-afte.text: What about it? It got out of control and you killed it. Saves the beastmaster a job.

guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-afte.player: But it could have killed me! You said it would be safe.

guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-afte.speaker: Lelia
guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-afte.text: You survived, didn't you? I don't see the problem.

guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-afte.speaker: Lelia
guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-afte.text: Now, I need to get things ready for the next slot. Why don't you go and tell Emelio about the good impression his kebabs made.

guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-agai.speaker: Lelia
guerilla-marketing-talking-to-lelia-agai.text: I don't think you need anything else, do you? Why don't you go and tell Emelio about the good impression his kebabs made.

wrapping-up.speaker: Emelio
wrapping-up.text: Nilsal, friend. Given that I've already served our first customers, I take it your trip to the Colosseum was a success?

wrapping-up.player: Well I did run into a slight complication, but apart from that, it went very well.

wrapping-up.speaker: Emelio
wrapping-up.text: You have done a great service to Varlamore, friend. Thanks to you, all here will be able to indulge in the joy that is kebabs. As thanks, I will offer you a special price for any kebabs you buy!

wrapping-up.player: Do I not get to share in any of the profits, given I helped set it all up?

wrapping-up.speaker: Emelio
wrapping-up.text: Sorry, friend, but I must prepare some more kebabs for our next customers! Until next time.
